name: rootprint-body-json-path-queries
description: body field is type json: token queries need the path form `body.message:term` (AND-composable); phrase queries on body are rejected (field has no positions indexed). The local bench stack logs under service_name:fabro-lokal; production is service_name:fabro. ULID birth timestamp decodes from the first 10 chars (Crockford base32, ms).
